claim_boundary: Paired mechanism and kinematic-safety benchmark under the calibrated grasp-skill proxy; not a contact-dynamics success-rate claim.

T1_reactive_geometry_ik.label: Reactive geometry + IK
T1_reactive_geometry_ik.perception: same public RGB-D plus primitive shape heuristic
T1_reactive_geometry_ik.grasp: power for wide cube; pinch for narrow cylinder
T1_reactive_geometry_ik.wrist_yaw_deg: single globally tuned yaw, frozen for every layout
T1_reactive_geometry_ik.monitor: replan on any detected scene change
T1_reactive_geometry_ik.semantics: no protected-object relation or task memory

A2_agentic_rag_vlm.label: Agentic RAG-VLM
A2_agentic_rag_vlm.perception: same public RGB-D grounded by VLM/semantic adapter
A2_agentic_rag_vlm.wrist_yaw_deg: candidate selected by posture, joint margin and protected clearance
A2_agentic_rag_vlm.monitor: replan only when a pending target becomes stale
A2_agentic_rag_vlm.semantics: protected-glass scene graph plus completed-subgoal memory

E2_protected_clearance.metric: minimum hand-to-protected-glass clearance during terminal descent

E3_change_attribution.metric: target-change replan precision, recall and unnecessary-replan rate

E4_combined.metric: all required mechanism gates pass in the same trial
